Legend of the River King GBC.name: Legend of the River King GBC
Legend of the River King GBC.summary:
The Game Boy Color version of the fishing role playing game Legend of the River King.

The game consists of two separate modes:

"Fish" which is the main RPG mode where you set out to find the Guardian fish.

"Raise" in which you purchase a fish tank and raise a small fish in hopes for it to grow. Similar to that of a Tamagotchi.

Turok - Rage Wars.name: Turok: Rage Wars
Turok - Rage Wars.summary: Turok: Rage Wars is a 2D action-adventure video game for the Game Boy Color, developed by Bit Managers and published by Acclaim Entertainment. Unlike its Nintendo 64 counterpart, Turok: Rage Wars is a single player game that serves as a direct sequel to the Game Boy Color version of Turok 2: Seeds of Evil.
